meta.name: scope
meta.description: Assess a new customer request against agreed scope, trade-offs and ownership. Use when an engagement expands or a custom feature needs a commitment decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估新需求是否超出约定范围,给出取舍与归属判断
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户临时加需求,你需要判断该不该答应。
copy.tagline_en: Judge whether a new customer request fits the agreed scope before you commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a client keeps adding requests and you must decide what to commit

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把新客户请求拿去对照已约定的范围、取舍与归属，判断该不该做承诺。它会先读任务上下文契约和方法文档，保留未知项，并区分实现、验证、部署与验收。
howto.when: 当合作范围扩大，或某个定制功能需要做出承诺决定时触发。若由 @fde 调用，则复用它当前的脱敏数据包与范围，不重启设置或已答问题。

say.text: 客户想加一个定制功能，帮我对照已定范围判断要不要承诺
say.note: 会给出取舍与归属的分析

say.text: 这个需求超出我们约定的范围了吗？
say.note: 会区分实现、验证、部署与验收

say.text: 按 hold-scope 方法评估这个新请求
say.note: 会先读方法文档再逐项评估

howto.what_en: Claude assesses a new customer request against the agreed scope, trade-offs and ownership. It reads the task context contract and method, preserves unknowns, and separates implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an engagement expands or a custom feature needs a commitment decision. If called by @fde, it reuses the current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: A customer wants a custom feature — check it against agreed scope.
say_en.note: Returns trade-offs and an ownership call

say_en.text: Is this request outside the agreed scope?
Assess this new request using the hold-scope method.
say_en.note: Reads the method, then evaluates point by point
